subject.title: ui-e2e: two chat-flow tests fail on main (workspace rail visibility, worktree chat sidebar action)

question: After the sessions-sidebar redesign, should managed-worktree chat creation be tested only through the new-session page, or should the `New chat in worktree` sidebar shortcut be restored?
rationale: Current main retains managed-worktree creation on the new-session page but no longer renders the button expected by the sidebar E2E; source alone cannot safely determine whether that shortcut removal was intentional.

options.title: Use new-session flow
options.body: Treat the new-session page as the canonical worktree entry point and update the E2E to exercise that visible flow and its `sessions.create` request.

options.title: Restore sidebar shortcut
options.body: Restore the agent-sidebar worktree action and retain the existing E2E contract if the shortcut remains part of the intended UX.

recommendation.title: Use new-session flow
recommendation.body: Treat the new-session page as the canonical worktree entry point and update the E2E to exercise that visible flow and its `sessions.create` request.

likelyOwner.reason: The same person introduced managed-worktree chat creation and authored the sessions-sidebar redesign that changed the affected entry point.
